# No Input Validation or Sanitization of Query Parameters

User-provided values for 'query', 'query_vector', 'entity_types', and 'limit' are used directly in queries and logic without validation or sanitation, which may lead to unexpected behavior or errors if malformed input is passed (e.g., very large limits, invalid types, empty queries).
